sources.supported_scope: repeated abusive and coercive conduct in a family setting; later precautionary measures

supported_facts: The official source explicitly describes reiterated abusive and coercive conduct rather than one isolated incident.
The source reports verbal, physical and psychological abuse across time, including earlier conduct and a later threat in May 2022.
The June 2022 custodial/electronic-monitoring measures are procedural responses and not new criminal EVENT occurrences.

event_identity_analysis.rationale: The source itself frames the alleged maltreatment as reiterated conduct over time. Splitting it into invented discrete incidents would overstate source granularity.
event_identity_analysis.split_condition: Only separately documented occurrences with independent date/place anchors should become distinct related EVENTs.

temporal_analysis.end_context: May 2022 latest described conduct before procedural action
temporal_analysis.caution: Do not infer an initial date from family history or from the date of the police measure.

geography_analysis.publication_rule: suppress point geometry; municipality-level context at most unless a stricter privacy review permits less

offence_analysis.reported_family: maltreatment in family / repeated domestic abuse

recommended_resolution: Model as one course_of_conduct EVENT candidate with open/uncertain start and high-vulnerability geoprivacy. Any public projection should suppress point geometry and avoid identifying family detail.
publication_blockers: Human privacy/legal review required before any approved public bundle.
Exact private residence must not enter public geometry.
